description: This Java class is a command handler for processing buy-down fee adjustment requests in a loan portfolio application. It implements the 'NewCommandSourceHandler' interface, uses Spring framework annotations, and invokes a service to perform the fee adjustment while handling potential data integrity exceptions.

classes.name: BuyDownFeeAdjustmentCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service component that handles commands to adjust buy-down fees on loans, encapsulating the logic for invoking the service and handling data integrity errors.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes a JSON command to adjust buy-down fees. It delegates to the platform service and manages exceptions related to data integrity.
